summary: Exercise the complete public release verification coordinator
details: Add a bounded property for the actual public release coordinator, beyond its policy, argument and file helper coverage; register all 45 native targets.
Use actual synthetic file hashes and a private fixture pin to cover legacy file, repository, revoked-source, root and required-file joins without changing the committed trust policy.

Require both verifier failure positions to propagate with exact artifact and identity arguments, a credential-free environment and immutable inputs. No provider call or cryptographic success is supplied by a command-port acknowledgement.

compatibility.notes: Test tooling only. Production verification behavior, publisher policy, accepted release profiles and historical signing/hash commitments are unchanged.

security: Keep local artifact/pin binding separate from provider or cryptographic assurance; malformed and tampered inputs cannot acquire the declared consistency result.
limitations: The positive fixture establishes consistency with a synthetic local pin, not official release trust.
The nonlegacy command model always fails the whole verification operation; it supplies no provider observation or accepted cryptographic result.
